cases.question: 分析一下最近30天的销量，你能得出什么结论？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
最近30天销量整体增长，但类目和商品分化明显。
- 本期销量42162件、订单16075单、GMV 9665990.5元、客单价601.31元，四项均高于上期 [查询1]。
- 增长主力是鞋靴（+380件）、宠物（+268件）、运动户外（+243件）；男装销量-89件、GMV-38364.22元，下滑最多 [查询4]。
- 渠道上短视频增速最快（+9.4%），站外联盟（-3.0%）和品牌广告（-1.0%）销量下滑 [查询5]。
- 单品中文具热销款45号+71件、宠物热销款209号+68件；厨具热销款183号-55件最明显 [查询2][查询3]。
- 建议：优先补货鞋靴、宠物、运动户外及45号、209号，排查183号、139号下滑原因并调整男装投放。

cases.question: 最近生意怎么样？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 周期, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
最近30天生意整体向好，GMV、订单、销量、客单价均高于上期。
- 本期GMV 9,665,990.5元、订单16,075单、销量42,162件、客单价601.31元，四项均高于上期 [查询1]。
- 增长主力是宠物（GMV +122,199.08，+17.6%）、运动户外（+98,471.64，+12.8%）、鞋靴（+77,529.60，+12.4%）；男装下滑最多（-38,364.22，-11.3%）[查询3]。
- 渠道中社交种草GMV环比+11.4%最快，站外联盟-1.8%、品牌广告-1.7%为负 [查询2]。
- 退货率从3.9%升至4.3%，退款金额419,373.63元，七天无理由和尺码不符金额最高 [查询5][查询4]。
- 建议：加大宠物热销款209号等增长款的备货与投放，同时排查男装下滑原因并优化尺码说明以降退货。

cases.question: 帮我看看退货情况，有什么问题吗？
cases.sql: SELECT r.reason AS 退款原因, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期退款金额, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN 1 END) AS 本期退款笔数, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期退款金额, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' THEN 1 END) AS 上期退款笔数, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 退款金额变化, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02' THEN 1 END) AS 退款笔数变化 FROM safe.refunds AS r WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND ((r.completed_at >= '2026-10-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01') OR (r.completed_at >= '2026-09-02' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-02')) GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY 退款金额变化 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
退货率小幅上升，退款集中在“不喜欢”和付费搜索渠道。

- 本期退款 419,373.63 元、1,457 笔，退货率 4.3%，上期为 3.9%，退款金额和笔数都在增加 [查询2]。
- 退款金额增长最多的是“不喜欢”，增加 22,639.42 元、51 笔；其次是“发错货”，增加 13,663.94 元、22 笔 [查询1]。
- 渠道方面，付费搜索退款环比增长 59.4%，直播带货增长 36.8%，老客复购增长 26.4%；只有品牌广告下降 37.0% [查询5]。
- 商品层面，手机配件热销款204号退款 10,241.72 元，母婴热销款22号从 1,611.23 元升至 9,552.34 元 [查询3]。
- 建议：先核查付费搜索和直播带来的流量质量，再对“不喜欢”增长集中的手机配件热销款220号、204号检查商品描述和图片是否与实物一致。
- 缺少按商品合并计算的退货率数据，因为第3步合并查询未执行成功，无法判断哪些商品退货率最高。

cases.question: 下个月我应该重点推哪些商品？
cases.sql: SELECT p.id AS 商品编号, p.name AS 商品名称, SUM(ads.spend) AS 广告花费, SUM(ads.attributed_gmv) AS 归因成交金额, SUM(ads.attributed_orders) AS 归因订单数, ROUND(SUM(ads.attributed_gmv) / NULLIF(SUM(ads.spend), 0), 2) AS ROI, ROUND(SUM(ads.clicks) / NULLIF(SUM(ads.impressions), 0) * 100, 1) AS 点击率百分比 FROM safe.ad_daily_stats AS ads JOIN safe.ad_campaigns AS c ON c.id = ads.campaign_id JOIN safe.products AS p ON p.id = c.product_id WHERE ads.stat_date >= '2026-10-02' AND ads.stat_date < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 归因成交金额 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
下月优先推宠物、文具、运动户外类的高增长低退货商品。
- 宠物热销款209号本期GMV 142,328.42，环比+61.8%，退货率3.2%，体量大且增长快 [查询5][查询7]
- 文具热销款45号本期GMV 147,736.23，环比+59.4%，退货率5.1%，是体量最大的增长款 [查询5][查询7]
- 运动户外热销款237号环比+67.7%，退货率仅3.7%，但本期GMV 42,642.43，体量偏小 [查询6][查询7]
- 鞋靴105号、文具236号、家居243号增速虽高，退货率分别17.6%、23.6%、22.4%，暂不宜主推 [查询7]
- 建议：把209号和45号作为主推，237号小步加投测试；广告数据只覆盖5个商品，无法判断这三款的投放效率，需补投后看ROI [查询2]

cases.question: 今天有什么需要我注意的？
cases.sql: SELECT c.name AS 渠道, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-31' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 今日GMV, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-31' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END) AS 今日订单数, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-31' THEN o.id END) AS 上期订单数 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-30' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 今日GMV DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
今天订单和GMV双升，但退货率与客单价需留意。
- 订单566单、GMV 332451.1，均高于上期506单、322549.77；客单价587.37，低于上期637.45 [查询3]。
- 退货率4.6%，上期3.1%；退款增加集中在运动户外（+5932.56）、鞋靴（+4646.42）、美妆（+3781.0）[查询4][查询6]。
- 美妆GMV减少11658.63、宠物减少12207.07；短视频渠道GMV从16447.13升至27065.69 [查询5][查询1]。
- 建议：优先核查运动户外、鞋靴、美妆的退款原因，并复核站外联盟计划ROI 2.01的投放效率 [查询6][查询2]。

cases.question: 上个月GMV为什么比上上个月低？
cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01' THEN '上个月' ELSE '上上个月' END AS 期间, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01')) GROUP BY 期间 LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
上个月GMV并未下滑，反而高于上上个月，问题前提不成立。
- 上个月GMV 9,072,501.5，上上个月8,114,142.58；订单数15,345对13,917，客单价591.24对583.04，三项均上升 [查询1]。
- 20个类目中仅宠物GMV微降410.88，其余19个均增长，运动户外增96,923.79最多 [查询2]。
- 8个渠道GMV全部上升，短视频增115,579.22，付费搜索增178,646.15最多 [查询3]。
- 建议：先核对“下滑”的说法是否指其他时间段或口径；若关注成本，可复盘已停投的活动9号、32号、36号、30号，它们上期归因GMV较高 [查询4]。

cases.question: 最近30天广告投放效果怎么样，钱花得值吗？
cases.sql: SELECT c.campaign_name AS 活动名称, ch.name AS 投放渠道, c.daily_budget AS 日预算, SUM(ads.spend) AS 花费, SUM(ads.attributed_gmv) AS 归因成交金额, ROUND(SUM(ads.attributed_gmv) / NULLIF(SUM(ads.spend), 0), 2) AS ROI, SUM(ads.clicks) AS 点击量, SUM(ads.attributed_orders) AS 归因订单数 FROM safe.ad_daily_stats AS ads JOIN safe.ad_campaigns AS c ON c.id = ads.campaign_id LEFT JOIN safe.channels AS ch ON ch.id = c.channel_id WHERE ads.stat_date >= '2026-10-02' AND ads.stat_date < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.campaign_name, ch.name, c.daily_budget ORDER BY 花费 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
最近30天广告ROI 1.75，低于上期2.07，钱花得不如上期值。
- 本期花费216,670.86元、归因成交379,574.74元、ROI 1.75；上期ROI 2.07，投放规模大幅收缩 [查询3]。
- 社交种草ROI最高2.76，站外联盟1.81，品牌广告1.41，付费搜索最低1.18 [查询2]。
- 品牌广告花费66,811.43元但ROI仅1.41，站外联盟花费120,349.54元占大头 [查询1]。
- 建议：把预算从品牌广告、付费搜索向社交种草倾斜，并核查站外联盟ROI下滑原因。

cases.question: 哪个渠道最值得加大投入？
cases.sql: SELECT c.name AS 渠道名称, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END) AS 本期订单数, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN o.id END), 0), 2) AS 本期客单价, SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN o.id END) AS 上期订单数, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN o.id END), 0), 2) AS 上期客单价, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 1) AS GMV环比增长率 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02')) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 本期GMV DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
社交种草最值得加大投入，规模大、增速快、ROI最高。
- 社交种草本期GMV 158.0万，环比+11.4%，在GMV前三大渠道中增速最快，客单价从589.43升至612.56 [查询1]。
- 社交种草ROI 2.76，为四个有投放渠道中最高，花费仅21007.22，归因成交58019.91 [查询2]。
- 退款率3.6%，低于自然搜索4.5%和付费搜索4.8%，成交质量较好 [查询3]。
- 新客订单占比2.8%，各渠道差异很小（2.4%–3.3%），拉新优势不明显 [查询4]。
- 建议：优先把增量预算投向社交种草，小步加投并跟踪ROI与退款率变化；站外联盟、品牌广告ROI偏低且GMV下滑，暂不追加。

cases.question: 本月退款为什么变多了？
cases.sql: SELECT p.id AS 商品ID, p.name AS 商品名称, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 本期退款金额, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.id END) AS 本期退款笔数, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 上期退款金额, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' THEN r.id END) AS 上期退款笔数, SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01' THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 退款金额增长 FROM safe.refunds AS r JOIN safe.orders AS o ON r.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE r.status = 'completed' AND ((r.completed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-11-01') OR (r.completed_at >= '2026-09-01' AND r.completed_at < '2026-10-01')) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 退款金额增长 DESC LIMIT 15
cases.summary:
本月退款确实变多，退货率从3.9%升到4.3%，增幅快于GMV。

- 本月退款427,809.93元、1,493笔，上期356,867.86元、1,295笔，金额和笔数双升 [查询4]。
- 原因上“不喜欢”增加24,237.96元、“发错货”增加16,469.12元、“尺码不符”增加14,904.43元，是主要增量 [查询3]。
- 渠道上付费搜索增加27,222.54元（+64.5%）、直播带货增加14,699.23元（+38.4%），增量集中在这两个渠道 [查询2]。
- 商品上鞋靴118号增加8,843.43元、母婴23号增加7,823.78元、箱包188号增加7,562.87元，且多与“发错货”“不喜欢”相关 [查询1][查询5]。
- 建议：先核查付费搜索和直播渠道的发货准确性，并对鞋靴118号、母婴23号、箱包188号做尺码说明和详情页优化。

数据只能说明退款集中在哪些原因、渠道和商品，具体诱因需进一步核实。

cases.question: 最近物流有没有拖后腿？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at)), 1) AS 平均发货时效小时, COUNT(*) AS 已签收包裹数 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期', ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at)), 1), COUNT(*) FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
整体物流没有明显拖后腿，但个别承运商和偏远省份需关注。
- 本期已签收包裹 14382 个，平均发货时效 200.7 小时，上期 200.8 小时，基本持平 [查询1]。
- 韵达未签收占比从 10.6% 升到 11.3%，为本期最高；顺丰从 10.1% 升到 10.3% [查询3]。
- “物流太慢”退款本期 225 笔、65203.46 元，上期 217 笔、58760.78 元，略有上升 [查询2]。
- 四川、河南、河北、陕西、辽宁时效在 272–279.1 小时，远高于整体约 200 小时；辽宁变慢 4.1 小时 [查询5]。
- 建议：先核查韵达未签收占比上升的原因，并对辽宁线路做时效排查；数据看不出具体原因，需进一步查物流明细。
- 缺数据：无步骤失败，但退款上升与时效变化之间的因果关系无法从现有数据判断。

cases.question: 各类目最近表现怎么样，哪些在下滑？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期', SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500

cases.question: 老客复购情况怎么样？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 周期, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS 复购客户数, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 复购订单数, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), 2) AS GMV FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE c.name = '老客复购' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 周期, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS 复购客户数, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 复购订单数, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), 2) AS GMV FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.channels AS c ON c.id = o.channel_id WHERE c.name = '老客复购' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
老客复购整体稳中有升，老客是复购主力。
- 老客复购渠道本期复购客户 2161 人、复购订单 2201 单、GMV 130.8 万，均高于上期的 2047 人、2097 单、120.0 万 [查询1]。
- 按注册时间分层，老客复购客户 2135 人、复购 GMV 149.7 万、客单价 601.37，上期为 1966 人、131.9 万、592.04 [查询2]。
- 渠道占比上，老客复购占本期复购 GMV 13.5%，高于上期 13.3%；自然搜索占比最高为 23.7% [查询3]。
- 类目复购 GMV 前三为手机配件 206.9 万、运动户外 198.1 万、宠物 189.6 万 [查询4]。
- 建议：对老客复购占比高的手机配件、运动户外类目做定向老客召回，并核对第2步渠道占比变化未完整输出的部分。

cases.question: 上个月客单价为什么下降了？
cases.sql: SELECT '本期' AS 期间, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-01' UNION ALL SELECT '上期' AS 期间, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
整体客单价并未下降，9月反而高于8月，问题前提不成立。
- 9月客单价591.24，8月583.04，GMV和订单数也同步增长 [查询1]
- 折扣率两期均为12.5%，件单价从226.32微降至226.04，促销未加深 [查询2]
- 局部确有下滑：直播带货客单价597.11降至571.96（-4.2%）；家居类目-7.7%、美妆-7.0% [查询4][查询3]
- 建议：先核对“客单价下降”的说法来自哪个渠道或类目，再针对直播带货和家居、美妆的高价SKU做定价与搭配检查；整体层面无需调整促销。

cases.question: 最近30天哪些地区卖得好，哪些地区需要加强？
cases.sql: SELECT o.province AS 收货省份, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS 已签收包裹数, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.paid_at, s.delivered_at)), 1) AS 平均发货时效小时 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.shipments AS s ON s.order_id = o.id WHERE NOT s.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' GROUP BY o.province ORDER BY 平均发货时效小时 DESC LIMIT 500
cases.summary:
北京、浙江、河南增长最快，广东体量最大但微降，江西、安徽、山东需加强。

- 增长最快：北京 GMV 739,217.82 元（+20.7%）、浙江 1,091,336.55 元（+17.9%）、河南 600,796.56 元（+16.6%）[查询2]

cases.question: 童装类目最近怎么样？
cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01' THEN '本期' ELSE '上期' END AS 周期, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS GMV, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS 订单数, SUM(oi.quantity) AS 销量, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS 客单价 FROM safe.orders AS o JOIN safe.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN safe.products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN safe.categories AS c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE c.name = '童装' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND ((o.paid_at >= '2026-10-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-11-01') OR (o.paid_at >= '2026-09-02' AND o.paid_at < '2026-10-02')) GROUP BY 周期 LIMIT 500

- 渠道上老客复购+41.7%、短视频+24.9%；品牌广告-24.8%、站外联盟-23.7% [查询2]。
